name: figma-local-mcp
description: Local Figma MCP with a design skill, configurable UI-library rules and style-guide creation.

interface.shortDescription: Style guides and layouts through a local Figma plugin.
interface.longDescription: Create and edit native layouts with local MCP, design tokens, components and configurable project rules. Includes a shadcn/ui reference profile. Requires Node.js and a running Figma development plugin.
defaultPrompt: Создай style guide и экран через локальный Figma MCP.
Примени UI-библиотеку и правила дизайна моего проекта.
